name: Hildr
source:
She has a calm demeanor, but is also a composed commander. She secretly has feelings for Thor, the God of thunder. This feeling is expressed in her loyalty to Thor on a daily basis.

She wants to raise Thrud to be a great Valkyrie, for the secret purpose of attracting Thor's interest. On the other hand, she is jealous of Sif, Thor's wife. When she sees Sif's influence on Thrud's words and actions, she becomes somewhat harsh towards her.

She trusts Rota as her competent subordinate. She sometimes gets a little irritated when Rota oversteps the boundary between superior and subordinate.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150503155628/http://www.matsuri-kikaku.com/matsuri/val2/val2_cha1.html]archived official site[/url]]
